requirements.rule: Art. 58 bis and Art. 55 bis: the child sickness indemnity from 2027 and the oncological permits.
requirements.remediation: Model the indemnity of Art. 58 bis and the permits of Art. 55 bis.

requirements.rule: Art. 23 flexible hours above 40 per week (15% weekday, 20% Saturday) remain outside the model: they are not overtime. Art. 29 banked overtime pays half the applicable overtime premium now; the elected rest balance and eventual payout at current pay are not tracked. The election covers all overtime in the month and must be declared by the next month; callers must supply a consistent banked choice for each month's events.
requirements.remediation: Model flexible schedule hours and compensation windows separately from overtime, and track elected overtime rest balances and their later liquidation.

requirements.rule: Art. 32(b,c) holiday top-ups are modelled for sickness, compulsory maternity and injury, excluding letter a) and 4 October. A stated patron_saint_day covers the local patron day, its locally agreed substitute, or Rome-only 29 June when applicable. Without the applicable local date from the employer, these holidays cannot be calculated.
requirements.remediation: State the applicable local patron holiday date (including a locally agreed substitute or Rome-only 29 June) as employer.patron_saint_day.

requirements.rule: Renewal of 4 June 2026: the IPCA top-up of June 2027 and 2028 above 2.653% and 2.729%.
requirements.remediation: Model the IPCA top-up when the index is published.

requirements.rule: Art. 29 row i and the shift-worker column of the overtime rows: night holiday work with compensatory rest (35%, 30%), night overtime 40%/45% and night holiday overtime 65% of shift workers. The ordinary night (25% until 22, 35% after; 25% for shift workers), holiday (55%), compensatory-rest (10%) and night holiday (60%, 55%) premiums are modelled.
requirements.remediation: Model row i and the shift-worker column of the Art. 29 overtime rows.

requirements.rule: LEAVE, CONTO ORE (Art. 22, p. 94): the residual PAR of a year are paid with the December pay two years later (work_rules.leave_rules.permit_deadline). Not modelled: 'L’attivazione del Conto ore individuale avverrà previo accertamento presso gli Enti previdenziali competenti' of the contributions on the hours set aside; the engine treats the conto ore as active.
requirements.remediation: State whether the conto ore of the firm is active (the INPS check of art. 22) and, if not, pay the residual PAR at the end of their year.

requirements.rule: LEAVE, PAR (Artt. 21-22, 24 and renewal of 4 June 2026, p. 18): the engine adds 8 hours for the whole-workforce sectors of Art. 21(b), 8 for qualifying rotating shifts outside steel, and 4 for all workers from 2029. Not modelled: the Art. 21(a) production/maintenance-area restriction (and southern auto shift exception), the steel shift permit paid with the Christmas bonus instead of credited, the 2027–28 four hours restricted to production units of at least 50 workers (employer headcount is not unit headcount), and absorption by company-level reductions. The 104-hour base remains payable for all workers.
requirements.remediation: Model worker production area and unit headcount, steel shift monetisation and company-level offsets; the 2027–28 four hours cannot use employer headcount as unit headcount.

requirements.rule: Sickness not modelled: the comporto prolungato (9/13.5/18 months) and its treatment, short absences counted double from the eighth in the triennio, hospital stays over 10 days and sickness over 21 days left out of the pay limits (60/75/90 days, at most 120), the 2026 disability extension at 50% (renewal p. 27). The comporto breve and its full and half pay over three years are sickness_rules.cumulation.
requirements.remediation: Model the residual sickness rules of Art. 55.

requirements.rule: Art. 33: leave on a 6-day week and the transitional extra day.
requirements.remediation: Model the leave of a 6-day week.

requirements.rule: Art. 28: reperibilità (amounts by group of levels adjusted each June) and trasferta.

The Sunday holiday quota is modelled. Art. 32 former legal operai hours cover national and stated local patron weekday holidays from 2009; Art. 38 December annual payment is separate. Unstated patron days, hourly elements beyond fixed monthly pay and nonstandard company holiday arrangements not specified by the caller remain outside the calculation.
requirements.remediation: State the local patron day and company holiday offset when applicable; supply non-monthly hourly elements when available.
